text_visible: Objectives and significance 目标与意义
Develop probing classifiers (linear probes, sparse autoencoders) to detect and quantify emotional states within LLM hidden representations across different layers and attention heads.
Design causal intervention methods (activation patching, steering vectors, representation engineering) to controllably manipulate LLM emotional responses without degrading general task performance.
Collect and curate a human daily-life emotion benchmark dataset using experience sampling methodology (ESM), establishing ground-truth affective dynamics for alignment evaluation.
Build an emotion alignment framework that maps LLM internal emotional representations onto human affective space, enabling realistic emotion simulation and generation.
Evaluate alignment quality through behavioral experiments, comparing LLM-simulated emotional responses with real human affective patterns across diverse daily-life contexts.
